Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning competency to stand trial evaluations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to competency to stand trial evaluations; adding anew section to chapter 10.77 RCW; creating a new section; and providingan expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.77 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If, at the time of a referral for an evaluation of competencyto stand trial in a jail for an incustody defendant, the departmenthas not met its performance target for timely completion of competencyevaluations under RCW 10.77.068(1)(a)(ii) during the most recentquarter in fifty percent of cases submitted by the referring county, asdocumented in the most recent quarterly report under RCW 10.77.068(3)or confirmed by records maintained by the department, the state shallreimburse the county for the cost of appointing a qualified expert orprofessional person under RCW 10.77.060(1)(a) as provided in thissection. (2) Appointment of a qualified expert or professional person underthis section must be from a list of qualified experts or professional p. 1 ESSB 5551persons assembled with participation by representatives of theprosecuting attorney and the defense bar of the county. (3) A qualified expert or professional person appointed by a courtfor an indigent person under this section must be compensated forcompetency evaluations in an amount that will encourage indepthevaluation reports. The department must reimburse the county in anamount determined by the department to be fair and reasonable with thecounty paying any excess costs. The amount of reimbursementestablished by the department must at least meet the equivalent amountfor evaluations conducted by the department. (4) Nothing in this section precludes either party from objectingto the appointment of an evaluator on the basis that an inpatientevaluation is appropriate under RCW 10.77.060(1)(d). (5) This section expires June 30, 2016.

Within current resources, the office of thestate human resources director shall gather market salary data relatedto psychologists and psychiatrists employed by the department of socialand health services and department of corrections and report to thegovernor and relevant committees of the legislature by June 30, 2013.
